notes:
Inbound SMB lead from a sales enablement app maker. Short, punchy notes from AE: 
- Use-case: automated call summaries, action-item extraction, CRM writeback (HubSpot).
- Workload: streaming transcript -> chunked summaries (chat-style requests) + embeddings for topic clustering.
- Latency/throughput: low concurrency (1–5 simultaneous calls), prefer <300ms per completion for UI feel; batching ok for backend jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: high — tight margins, looking for predictable per-call cost and a clear per-token estimate. Wants cost bands for 1k, 5k, 20k monthly calls.
- Model preferences: open to smaller open models for summaries; wants fallback to higher-quality model for complex calls.
- Security: must support SSO for internal studio, audit logs for operations, and retention controls (ability to auto-delete audio/transcripts after N days). Asked explicitly: "do you retain audio or transcripts by default? can we set retention to 7 days?"
- PII handling: they capture customer phone numbers and emails in transcripts. Want guidance / tooling for PII redaction or token-level masking. Asked about KMS and encryption-at-rest.
- Integration notes: using HubSpot CRM; wants example webhook for create-note with summary + actions.
- Quote from lead: "We need something we can version and forget — our customers won't accept mis-summarized action items."
- Trials: already used hosted API with sample workload; saw consistent summaries but wants SLA language for retention and data handling before converting.
- Internal stakeholders: founder/CTO (decision maker), eng lead (E2E integration), product manager (UX acceptance).
- Risk: churn risk if retention/PII controls not adequate or cost per active user too high.
- Good signals: completed trial, returned for follow-up, concrete usage numbers and HubSpot integration use-case.
- Ask: prepare 1-page retention/PII FAQ + short pricing bands and a 30-min security scoping call.
